title: Notepad++ Zero-Click RCE via Path Traversal (CVE-2026-52884)
summary: A critical zero-click remote code execution vulnerability in Notepad++ discovered through path traversal attack vector, tracked as CVE-2026-52884, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code without user interaction.
problem_solved: Addresses a critical security flaw that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute malicious code on受害者' systems via path traversal in Notepad++ file handling.
why_valuable: This is a critical security vulnerability with zero-click exploitation, meaning no user interaction is required, posing severe risk to all Notepad++ users worldwide.
